searchText: For 1) GLS254 is probably the fastest curve -- they should have benchmarks against Curve25519 which is the curve under Ristretto255 paper: <https://eprint.iacr.org/2023/1688.pdf> repo: <https://github.com/pornin/crrl> Though the repo does not look like it implements MSM, just scalar multiplications -- if your pedersen generators are fixed, you can probably try to use scalar mul with precomputations initially Oh if the characteristic is 2 and they perform like Ristretto that's truly awesome I can reduce the coefficients from 32N to about N in our RLNC POC. CC <@862973562243252234> Are you trying to optimize for CPU time? Looking at the dalek codebase, you could probably just optimize the MSM algorithm, if the issue is CPU time. This is better because GLS254 has not been as battle tested as Curve25519 and there is likely a Ristretto impl in each language. If its bandwidth, not sure as I've only skimmed the RLNC post
